design: Wren Ashdown: adult woman HALFLING rogue with curly chestnut hair, warm brown eyes, dark hooded leather, green-grey short cloak, shortsword in right hand, compact shortbow slung on back. Short natural halfling proportions, NOT childlike. Quick low shortsword thrust for attack.

Brother Odric Vale: older male DWARF paladin with stocky broad body and grey-streaked braided beard, chain mail, blue-grey tabard with original abstract star emblem, round shield and longsword. Grounded powerful sword slash for attack.

Tamsin Reed: adult woman wood ELF ranger, lean athletic body, pointed ears, auburn braided hair, studded leather, green-brown cloak, longbow in hands and shortsword sheathed at hip. Attack is a clear longbow draw, release, recovery; keep bow and string readable.

Sister Maren Holt: young adult HUMAN woman cleric, brown skin, dark braided hair, chain mail, cream-and-ochre tabard with plain original sun disk, shield and mace. Attack is mace raised, clear horizontal strike, recovery.

Pip Thistlewick: adult male rock GNOME wizard, short body with expressive face, sandy wild hair, goggles pushed above forehead, teal robes with many pockets, belt satchels, wooden quarterstaff. Attack: casting windup, staff pointed right with tiny blue spark at tip, recovery.
